evidence.description: USBD init writes: USBD_BA+0x704 = 0x220; USBD_BA+0x58 = 0x7f; REG_AHBCLK |= 0x50000; uses RAM pointers 0x00008190/0x000082B0 (+0x10e..+0x111, +0x4) based on USB_PHY_CTL bit 31.

summary: In APP.bin, FUN_002af9c0 directly writes to USBD registers: USBD_BA+0x704 (USB_PHY_CTL) is set to 0x220 and USBD_BA+0x58 (CEP_END_ADDR) set to 0x7f with a readback loop. It also enables USBD/HCLK3 via REG_AHBCLK (0xB0000204 |= 0x50000). The same function uses literals 0x00008190 and 0x000082B0 as RAM base pointers: bytes at +0x10e..+0x111 and a word at +0x4 are set based on USB_PHY_CTL bit 31. BSP USBD register map has no +0x190/+0x2B0 offsets, so these are RAM structures, not USBD regs.
title: USBD init routine at FUN_002af9c0 uses USBD PHY/CEP registers; RAM flags at 0x8190/0x82B0
